lessonsLearned: Mongoose Submission.extractedText schema field defaults to select: false; any batch text or vector extraction query must explicitly request .select('+extractedText').
FastAPI Celery default indexing route is asynchronous; synchronous batch embedding via @app.post('/index/sync') in main.py provides deterministic and immediate vector persistence into ChromaDB.

Container environment isolation requires scripts running inside cms-server to resolve server/.env via dotenv configuration (DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/app/server/.env) to guarantee JWT secret and API port parity.
Project search archive projection in searchArchive service must explicitly include courseId in .select() so downstream API payloads retain complete academic metadata.
